//: Deployment sample: copy it as context.json next to the package on the host. Never put real secrets here.
The merged configuration, later layers win:
4. in-package config/routemodule.config.json: ContextName and AutoStart only
Redb.local is the redb instance the routes use with storage="local". RedbInstanceName names the one
instance whose EnsureCreated runs (it creates the redb tables in an empty database).
Another database: change Provider and ConnectionString, nothing else.
UsePro with PropsSaveStrategy ChangeTracking: a save writes only the values that changed instead of
deleting and inserting the object's whole value set (DeleteInsert, the Free default). ChangeTracking needs Pro.
Caches: the props cache is off; to turn it on set EnablePropsCache true and size PropsCacheMaxSize to the
objects the module works with (a cache smaller than that evicts what it needs and gets slower than none).
The list cache is on. SkipHashValidationOnCacheCheck stays false on a cluster: a cache hit is checked
against the object's hash in the database, which catches changes made by other nodes.
